messages:
Maria S (Sales): @Arjun K @Kevin L — Thornfield wants to run a POC next week using a Dedicated small-fleet. Model: goliath-3.2q (16k ctx, 8-bit quant). They plan to stream chat with prefix KV caching and want private/on-prem later. Can eng + security confirm: 1) variant compatibility for q8 + KV cache, 2) expected p99 latency for ~2k concurrent chats, 3) rough monthly cost for ~10k reqs/day (avg 150 tokens) Hosted vs Dedicated, 4) blockers for security questionnaire (data residency + BYOK)?

Arjun K (Solutions): tagging @Lisa R and @Nate P. Kevin — can you outline runtime constraints and if we need a special build for goliath-3.2q? Also need a recommended shard layout for 16k.

Kevin L (Eng Runtime): Quick notes: goliath-3.2q is in catalog as a quant-optimized variant but not fully validated with our prefixed KV cache under q8 in every path. 8-bit should work, but fused-attention + KV needs validation. For 16k context we recommend 2x A100 shards (or 3x smaller) to keep latency steady. P99 single-token streaming on optimized path (no KV) ~230-300ms. With KV and long prefixes add ~15-30% depending on hit rate and shard layout.

Lisa R (Security): For the questionnaire: we can support SOC2, BYOK (KMS/HSM), VPC/private control plane, audit logs, and region-scoped residency (US/EU). On-prem/private requires enterprise SOW and security review. We'll need the filled questionnaire + model license to check redistribution/quantization permissions.

Nate P (Pricing): I'll run numbers and share a sheet. Ballpark: Hosted scenario depends on token price; rough Hosted estimate for 10k reqs/day @150 tokens ≈ 1.5M tokens/day -> monthly ballpark ~$40k–$120k depending on negotiated token rate and streaming vs batch. Dedicated reserved starting point ~ $30k–$60k/mo (committed) + overage. If they sign a 12mo commit we can offer ~15–25% off. I'll post a spreadsheet with two scenarios.

Kevin L (Eng Runtime): For a compatibility scan I need either the HF ref or a tarball of the model + config (vocab, model_config). If the model is private, an S3 presigned link works. Also share a small representative prompt set (10-20 prompts) to test prefix hit behavior.

Maria S (Sales): They said the model is private and will provide the S3 link and the completed questionnaire by EOD. Can we do a 1-hour POC kickoff Thu 09:00 PT? @deploy-bot can you pre-check Dedicated capacity for that slot?

deploy-bot: Capacity check queued — Dedicated pool (2xA100) shows 3 free slots at Thu 09:00 PT. Placeholder 'thornfield-poc' reserved for 2h. Reply with :thumbsup: to confirm reservation.

Lisa R (Security): Also: ask legal to attach the license text. We need to confirm quantization/serving rights and any export controls.

Arjun K (Solutions): I'll create the kickoff doc with endpoints, sample prompt set, perf harness, and success criteria. Will include an ETA for the compatibility scan results. Link will be posted here.

Maria S (Sales): Attaching their files: security-questionnaire.pdf and model link: https://s3.internal.example/thornfield/goliath-3.2q.tar.gz :eyes: Please confirm receipt and next steps.

Kevin L (Eng Runtime): Received. I'll run the compatibility scan today and post a short report (kv flag, mem footprint, recommended shard config). If we need a special runtime build I'll note TL;DR + ask eng-releases for a canary.

Nate P (Pricing): Spreadsheet ready — sharing soon. If they want a quick estimate now, reply and I'll DM numbers for Hosted vs Dedicated with a 12mo commit example.

Maria S (Sales): Thanks everyone — once Kevin posts the scan and Lisa confirms questionnaire gaps we'll lock the kickoff. :pray:
__notes: This thread is a single Slack thread string; messages are chronological and prefixed by sender name. No title field included per agents.md.
